description: Prepare one Distributor claim for every Merkl reward token the sender holds on a chain, from amounts and proofs fetched from https://api.merkl.xyz/v4/users/{address}/rewards/summary. The proofs are folded into their Merkle root here, and the read bundle checks it against the root the chain enforces, so Merkl's API need not be trusted. Distinct from prepare_rewards_claim, which claims Ekubo's own incentive drops.

rewards.description: One entry per reward token on this chain, all in one claim

amount.description: Merkl's cumulative amount, unchanged; not the claimable delta (positive decimal integer)

token.description: Reward token address exactly as Merkl returned it

sender.description: Claiming wallet; the leaf's user address

name: prepare_merkl_claim
title: Prepare a Merkl reward claim
